text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu agree on holding another meeting to try to resume Palestinian-Israeli negotiations.
- Mubarak to review new measure that aims to increase Egypt's exports to $11 billion annually.
- Parliament and Shura Assembly Affairs Minister Kamal el-Shazli says the cabinet approved applications to invest in the southern area of Toshka, site of the proposed new delta.
- Mubarak to visit the area of Toshka in early July. Agriculture Minister Youssef Wali says tenders for building the pumping station will be opened in August.
- Mubarak says in an interview with CNN that his meeting with Netanyhau was a good step forward.
- Egypt and Syria sign today six agreements, including the creation of a free-trade zone. Syrian Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi is in Cairo to attend the joint committee meetings.
